source.reference_project: God's Eye View (GEV) Open Surveillance Architecture
source.relationship_to_gev: adsb.lol serves as the primary community ADS-B/Mode-S aggregation backend and open telemetry reference architecture for the God's Eye View project.

geographic_coverage_query.target_airspace: Mumbai FIR (VABB / BOM) and coastal airspace

source.acquisition_method: Automated HTTP GET request to REST v2 geographic bounding circle endpoint with 25s timeout

verified_licence.data_licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0

attribution_requirements.required_credit: Must attribute source as 'adsb.lol and its contributors' and include notice of the ODbL license in any public distribution or Produced Work
attribution_requirements.share_alike_clause: ODbL v1.0 Section 4.4 requires public derivative databases to be distributed under ODbL v1.0
attribution_requirements.open_access_clause: ODbL v1.0 Section 4.6 prohibits DRM or technical measures that restrict access

provenance.origin: Airborne aircraft transponders (1090 MHz Mode-S / ADS-B Extended Squitter)
provenance.ingestion_layer: Volunteer SDR ground station receivers uploading via dump1090/readsb feeds
provenance.aggregation_layer: adsb.lol globally distributed ingestion and deduplication servers

source_limitations: Feeder Density Variation: Coverage is proportional to volunteer SDR receiver density; reduced fidelity over open ocean and unpopulated landmasses.
Temporal Snapshot: Per-request snapshot; requires continuous scheduled polling or WebSocket streaming for uninterrupted tracking.
MLAT Dilution of Precision: Multilaterated targets exhibit higher horizontal variance compared to GNSS-backed ADS-B.
Barometric Datum: Uncorrected pressure altitudes assume standard atmosphere (1013.25 hPa) rather than local QNH.
Uncooperative Targets: Aircraft with disabled or non-functioning transponders cannot be tracked.

governance_notice.notes: Source metadata prepared for formal BHIV MasterDB evaluation. No write or registration has been executed.

dataset.dataset_name: BHIV vNEXT Normalized Aircraft Observation Dataset
dataset.description: Standardized, schema-conformant, quality-validated snapshot of real-time ADS-B aircraft observations in the Mumbai Flight Information Region (FIR), collected from adsb.lol under ODbL v1.0 licensing.

licence.licence_name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0
licence.attribution_requirement: Attribute to 'adsb.lol and its contributors' and include ODbL notice
licence.share_alike_requirement: Any publicly distributed adapted database must be under ODbL v1.0

schema.format: JSON Tabular (Array of Normalized Aircraft Objects)

fields.name: aircraft_hex_id
fields.description: 24-bit ICAO aircraft hex transponder address (uppercase)

fields.name: callsign
fields.description: Flight callsign (whitespace stripped, uppercase)

fields.name: registration
fields.description: Aircraft civil/military tail registration number

fields.name: aircraft_type_icao
fields.description: ICAO aircraft model designator (e.g. B77L, A20N)

fields.name: squawk_code
fields.description: 4-digit octal secondary surveillance transponder code

fields.name: emitter_category
fields.description: ADS-B emitter category code (e.g. A3, A5)

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate rounded to 6 decimal places

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate rounded to 6 decimal places

fields.name: altitude_baro_ft
fields.description: Barometric pressure altitude in feet (0 if on ground)

fields.name: altitude_geom_ft
fields.description: Geometric altitude in feet above WGS84 ellipsoid

fields.name: is_on_ground
fields.description: True if aircraft is on ground surface, False if airborne

fields.name: ground_speed_kts
fields.description: Speed over ground in knots (>= 0)

fields.name: true_track_deg
fields.description: Course over ground in degrees clockwise from true north [0.0, 360.0]

fields.name: vertical_rate_fpm
fields.description: Rate of climb or descent in feet per minute

fields.name: position_age_seconds
fields.description: Latency in seconds since last geographic position report

fields.name: last_seen_seconds
fields.description: Latency in seconds since last transmission message received

fields.name: distance_from_center_nm
fields.description: Distance from query reference point in nautical miles

fields.name: bearing_from_center_deg
fields.description: Bearing angle from query reference point in degrees

fields.name: signal_rssi_db
fields.description: Received signal strength indicator in dBFS

fields.name: provenance
fields.description: Complete lineage block containing source endpoint, query center, and timestamps

transformations_applied: Unpacked aircraft records from raw API 'ac' collection container.
Mapped raw field keys to standardized domain attributes (hex, flight, r, t, alt_baro, gs, track).
Stripped trailing and leading whitespace on callsigns, registrations, and aircraft types.
Enforced uppercase formatting on all alphanumeric identifiers.
Validated WGS84 coordinate boundary constraints (latitude in [-90, +90], longitude in [-180, +180]).
Decoupled surface state: 'alt_baro: ground' mapped to is_on_ground=True and altitude_baro_ft=0.
Attached immutable audit provenance to each record.

checks_executed.description: 100% of cleaned coordinates within WGS84 bounds
Speeds, tracks, and altitudes within valid aviation envelopes

limitations: Temporal Snapshot: Dataset represents a discrete temporal query at 2026-10-03T08:26:35Z.
Regional Feeder Coverage: Ground receiver density determines boundary detection fidelity.
Line-of-Sight Decay: Radio horizon over open water reduces low-altitude oceanic coverage.
intended_consumers: Trajectory Prediction and Conflict Detection Agents

capability.capability_name: God's Eye View Airspace Aircraft Tracking Capability
capability.purpose: Provide near real-time spatial positioning, kinematic monitoring, and situational awareness for commercial and general aviation aircraft within monitored airspace sectors.

source_dataset_reference.data_licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0

inputs.name: center_latitude
inputs.description: Geographic center point latitude in decimal degrees [-90.0, 90.0]

inputs.name: center_longitude
inputs.description: Geographic center point longitude in decimal degrees [-180.0, 180.0]

inputs.name: search_radius_nm
inputs.description: Observation radius around center in nautical miles [1, 250]

inputs.name: filter_hex_id
inputs.description: Optional filter for specific 24-bit ICAO aircraft hex identifier

inputs.name: filter_callsign
inputs.description: Optional filter for specific commercial flight callsign prefix

outputs.name: aircraft_state_vectors
outputs.description: Array of normalized aircraft observations matching schema defined in dataset_record.json

outputs.name: query_metadata
outputs.description: Execution timestamp, observation count, and query bounding parameters

freshness_characteristics.typical_latency_seconds: < 1.5s from radio broadcast reception to normalized record output
freshness_characteristics.observation_age_metrics: Monitored via 'seen' and 'seen_pos' sensor age attributes

limitations: VHF Radio Line-of-Sight: Target aircraft below radar/SDR horizon or masked by terrain cannot report positions.
Feeder Infrastructure Availability: Relies on community SDR ground receiver uptime.
Transponder Dependency: Excludes military stealth or unequipped general aviation aircraft lacking Mode-S/ADS-B transponders.
possible_bhiv_consumers: Flight Route Deviation & Anomaly Detection Agent
Urban Air Mobility (UAM) Corridor Monitoring Agent
dependencies: adsb.lol REST API v2 network connectivity
BHIV MasterDB authorization and service bus routing (PENDING)
